title: Control-plane synchronization
rules: Cadre packets own shared control-plane synchronization.
Never mix product publication into a control-plane sync action.

sections.heading: Topology
sections.body: Use `cadre_action` with `project.topology` only when a workflow returns it.

sections.heading: Synchronization
sections.body: Use returned `project.sync_control_plane` actions for shared pre/post synchronization. Halt on failed remote verification.
